name: Chocolate Cakes
description: Historical recipe from The Virginia Housewife; Or, Methodical Cook (1824). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: nice brown sugar
ingredients.originalText: half a pound of nice brown sugar

instructions.text: Put half a pound of nice brown sugar into a quart of flour, sift it
Make it into a paste, with four ounces of butter melted in as much milk as will wet it
Knead it till light, roll it tolerably thin
Cut it in strips an inch wide, and just long enough to lay in a plate
Bake them on a griddle, put them in the plate in rows to checker each other
Serve them to eat with chocolate

source.author: Mary Randolph
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put half a pound of nice brown sugar into a quart of flour, sift it
2. Make it into a paste, with four ounces of butter melted in as much milk as will wet it
3. Knead it till light, roll it tolerably thin
4. Cut it in strips an inch wide, and just long enough to lay in a plate
5. Bake them on a griddle, put them in the plate in rows to checker each other
6. Serve them to eat with chocolate
